name: After recital D
title: REPORT on the control of the financial activities of the European Investment Bank Group – annual report 2024
part_text: Da. whereas the EIB should apply the highest standards of risk management, transparency and accountability, including systematic public disclosure of the methodologies used for additionality assessment, credit risk rating and climate impact measurement; whereas robust safeguards are necessary to prevent moral hazard, particularly in operations backed by EU budget guarantees and in large strategic projects;
